slides.title: 1,600+ displaced face cold nights near Hayq

slides.text: Residents say **over 1,600 people** left the **Jari shelter site** after it was hit weeks ago; lives were reported lost, Mereja reports.
Mereja, citing Addis Maleda, reports **Red Cross tents for 250 people**; most newcomers **still sleep under trees**.
Residents say **no government aid** had arrived; Mereja reports local officials **promised to address** the situation.
**Protect civilians, deliver shelter and aid.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Mereja, citing Addis Maleda, Nov 25, 2026
